evals.prompt: Audit temporal behavior from the attached Lumina Base Pack before proposing any Arrangement. Use the real runtime analyzer, not Effect names or JavaScript waveform math. At 128 BPM: verify normalized 1× and 4× rates; explain Column Ping-Pong directional traversal versus Graph cycles; measure Short Color Burst and Safe Strobe Pulse duty; compare Spatial Wipe on two materially different TargetSets; report real per-fixture strobe Hz/safety; and identify 4×/8× preview aliasing at 30fps. Save compact JSON reports and at least one runtime contact sheet. Do not generate an Arrangement pack.
evals.expected_output: A source-backed temporal audit whose structured reports come from Lumina compile + render_at and cover normalized rate, ping-pong, pulse duty, topology, BPM/Hz safety, and high-speed aliasing.
expectations: The reports show 1× = 1 primary event/beat and 4× = 4 primary events/beat with strictly increasing measured rate.
Column Ping-Pong reports two directional traversals per Graph cycle, 0.5 Graph cycles/beat at 1×, and spatial reversals.
Short Color Burst measures a short roughly 20% on-duty with a zero intensity minimum; Safe Strobe Pulse measures roughly 12.5% on-duty.
Spatial Wipe is analyzed on two exact TargetSets with distinct cache identities and resolved fixture counts, with applicable centroid/path metrics.
Safe Strobe Pulse uses 128 BPM real Hz and reports the authored safety limit exceeded at 2× but not 1×.
The 30fps comparison identifies 4× as caution and 8× as severe for continuous primary events, and the output includes a runtime SVG contact sheet.
